fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short name shown wherever this skill is suggested. Up to 140 characters.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One sentence on when the assistant should reach for this skill. Up to 500 characters.

fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: The playbook itself: steps, rules and examples the assistant follows when this skill applies. Up to 8000 characters.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Blank scopes keep the skill inside the site's own read and write allowances.

fields.label: Scope Read
fields.description: DocTypes this skill may read, one per line. Must stay inside the site's Allowed Read Doctypes.

fields.label: Scope Write
fields.description: Subset of Scope Read that the skill may draft through the approval-gated write tools.

fields.label: Publishing
fields.description: Sharing and provenance are curated by Intelligence Managers.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Only enabled skills are suggested to the assistant.

fields.label: Shared
fields.description: Shared skills are visible to every Intelligence user; only managers may share.

fields.label: Origin
fields.description: Seeded skills ship with the app; Learned skills are written by users or the assistant.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Revision number, bumped by the server when the skill is updated.
